config.grain_rationale: Each row of the 'Income tax details' sheet is one legal entity (identified by its ABN) for one income year of the ATO Corporate Tax Transparency report; the row reports the entity's total income, taxable income and tax payable. The financial figures are not business identifiers and are left unmapped. The PRRT details sheet is a separate licence/rent-resource table and is not part of this mapping.

record_id.rationale: ABN+Income year collides on 8 held-out rows (the same ABN appears for more than one income year / duplicate rows), so no column combination is reliably unique. A content hash over the full record is traceable and collision-safe.

fields.rationale: Header is 'Name' in an ATO statutory register extract keyed to ABN; values carry legal-form suffixes (PTY LTD, PTY LIMITED, LIMITED), i.e. registered legal persons. Header does not say 'legal name' explicitly and a few rows are misspelt ('LINITED'), hence moderate confidence.
Header is 'ABN'; 11-digit shape on all present values with 100% checksum validity.

Only rows whose name ends in an explicit company legal-form suffix (PTY LTD / PTY LIMITED / LIMITED / LTD) are mapped to 'company'; rows with no explicit business-form suffix are left unmapped (regex_extract yields nothing) so they default to 'unknown' rather than being guessed. Confidence kept moderate-low because a name suffix states the corporate form of the ATO registrant rather than a dedicated entity-type field.

constants.rationale: ATO statutory transparency register of Australian entities; all ABNs checksum-validate.

config.notes: Reader targets the 'Income tax details' sheet (header row 1). entity_type is emitted only when the Name ends with an explicit company suffix (416 of 435 discovery rows); entities without such a suffix get no entity_type observation (defaults to unknown). No ACN, address, status or registration-date columns exist, so those targets are left unset deliberately. record_id uses content_hash because ABN+Income year is not unique across held-out rows. observed_at falls back to the resource last-modified timestamp rather than being derived from the income year.
